title: TO14 independent confirmation: evidence and counterevidence
scope: This report interprets TO14 only. It is not a TO15 or combined-final confirmation conclusion.

paired_candidate_vs_within_job_native.limitation: Exploratory fixed-seed batch panel; adaptive screening is not independent confirmation

paired_candidate_vs_same_round_R11_051.limitation: Exploratory fixed-seed batch panel; adaptive screening is not independent confirmation

paired_candidate_vs_same_round_R26_051.limitation: Exploratory fixed-seed batch panel; adaptive screening is not independent confirmation

confirmed_observations.interpretation: The paired point estimate versus within-job native is positive, while paired point estimates versus both instantaneous controls are negative. All three two-batch bootstrap intervals include zero; their batch means have opposite signs. These are observed panel contrasts, not evidence that the candidate is reliably better or worse.

facts: TO14 summary reports a positive paired mean versus within-job native and negative paired means versus same-round R11_051 and R26_051.
The candidate has two valid elites in 100 slots, compared with one each for the two instantaneous controls; the candidate has valid_n 96, versus 97 for R11_051 and 96 for R26_051.
Candidate p90 strain is above the two same-round controls.
possible_bias_or_mechanism_hypotheses: The final-outcome-derived teacher prior may rank future selected descendants differently from the instantaneous selector used by R11_051/R26_051; the current paired data do not identify this as the cause of lower mean affinity.

Selection-conditioned survivor labels can overrepresent lineages that survived the historical policy; extinct futures are unobserved, not zero-valued. This could distort teacher credit, but these TO14 results alone do not estimate the direction or magnitude.
With only two independent batches, stochastic batch variation is a plausible source of the opposing batch signs and cannot be separated from a real policy effect.
facts_vs_hypotheses.hypotheses_are_not_identified: The report does not infer a causal explanation from these comparisons.

base_geometry_scope.limitation: Selected evidence family only; association and temporal derivatives do not establish a causal coordinate force

support.matching: Distinct immediate parents, common grandparent, nearest online score, no pair reuse; equal families and batches

matched_geometry_scope.limitation: Selected evidence family only; association and temporal derivatives do not establish a causal coordinate force

historical_feature_evidence_context.interpretation: These historical calculator scopes are contextual evidence, not per-TO14 measurements. Base outcome/geometry features and matched outcome/matched features are distinct. The two base feature-level corrected signals cannot be described as matched-branch signals; the matched scope has no corrected-significant feature. Contact and occupancy variables are geometric proxies, not energies or chemical interactions.

limitations: TO14 has two evaluation batches; the reported paired bootstrap intervals all include zero and batch contrasts change sign.
The development evidence indicates a mean censoring fraction of 0.9042577030812327; this describes the retrospective development-label source, not a separately measured TO14 censoring rate.
Related descendants and exact-copy families are not independent observations; batch count, not descendant count, is the relevant independent replication here.
The TO14 VJP records are first-order responses, not second-forward measured affinity changes.
No TO15 result is included, and this report makes no final two-panel confirmation claim.
